name: serum-2
notes: Xfer Serum 2 wavetable synth. Out of the box Serum responds only to the mod wheel (CC1) — Xfer: no default CC assignments besides CC1. Everything else is MIDI Learn: right-click a knob (filter cutoff, a macro, the LFO rate) > MIDI Learn, then send the CC this map uses (filter 74, volume 7, expression 11, macro1-8 = CC21-28). Save the assignments as your default MIDI map (default.mmp) so they survive preset changes; per-preset maps load only if 'Load MIDI Map from Preset' is enabled (off by default). Sidechain pumping: map 'volume'/'expression' or use Serum's own LFO. Glides: set the voice to Mono/Legato with portamento — notes marked 'glide' overlap the next by legato_overlap beats. Pitch automation assumes the default ±2 semitone bend range; set pitch_bend_range here if you change it (dives use the full bend). For a full tape-stop dive (12 semitones) set Serum's bend range to 12 and pitch_bend_range here to 12; at ±2 the dive is clamped to a whole-tone drop.
